# Geotech Data Hub - Borehole Log Editor

This is a field-engineer-friendly web app for logging soil and rock strata to AS1726 standards.
It features real-time validation and a live colored profile column.

## Pages
- `/` - Landing page
- `/log` - Main editor page with project details, strata data grid, and visual profile.

## Tech Stack
- TanStack Start v1
- React
- Tailwind CSS v4
- shadcn/ui
